verdict.rationale: Autumn documents a broad public API covering core billing, plan and customer actions. Its CLI manages features and plans as code, and `atmn pull` brings dashboard-created products into local config. Its MCP server exposes billing, customer, plan, balance and log tools. However, nothing explicitly claims or demonstrates full parity between the API and the dashboard UI, and no OpenAPI spec was found at standard paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that dashboard-only functions (e.g. settings, webhook configuration, team management) are API-accessible, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
